cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Warmly Enforced
cards.instruction: Remain kind and welcoming while enforcing increasingly restrictive rules without exception.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Welcome to the swimming club! You're very welcome to watch until your induction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Lovely. Can I join today's induction?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Absolutely, once you've observed one. Today you can watch from the gallery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The gallery's closed. Could I watch from the poolside?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love to have you there. Poolside access requires induction, though. Let's find you a brochure with a lovely view.

mechanism: Copy a swimmer's cold posture as a stop signal, then welcome them while escalating the invented access restrictions.
confusable: Not a knowledgeable lifeguard applying policy: B2 reveals the crossed arms were for warmth, and A3 saves face by maintaining the boundary.
comparison: Reception hospitality and a changing pool signal differ from a host's footwear rules.
seedUse: Uses swimming-club welcome/access contradiction; copied crossed arms and whistle are new circumstances.
